verdict.rationale: Apify's Actor model and client APIs support bulk data operations (e.g., startUrls lists with maxCrawlPages, tasks with multiple input schemas) and its CLI/API/webhooks enable orchestrating many item runs; docs show examples of batch input and chaining Actor runs. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a dedicated 'bulk operation' or batch-run API (e.g., running the same Actor against thousands of inputs in one call) and independent hands-on verification of large-scale batch throughput.
